note: x,y,w,h rects in pixels. frame_rects = per-effect sheet, combined_rects = combined sheet of the same frame size. Most effects are 16x16; explosion_large and level_up are 32x32. Projectile directions: up/left/down (and the other diagonals) are exact 90 degree turns of right / up_right. teleport "in" = "out" reversed. loop=false effects play once.
